scripts.test: node --no-warnings test/domain.mjs && node --no-warnings test/session.mjs && node --no-warnings test/run.mjs
scripts.build:sim: COCOAPODS_PARALLEL_CODE_SIGN=NO xcodebuild -workspace ios/app.xcworkspace -scheme app -configuration Release -sdk iphonesimulator -destination 'generic/platform=iOS Simulator' build | tail -2
scripts.build:device: COCOAPODS_PARALLEL_CODE_SIGN=NO xcodebuild -workspace ios/app.xcworkspace -scheme app -configuration Release -destination 'generic/platform=iOS' -allowProvisioningUpdates build | tail -2
